contract.goal: Implement toRoman(n) in src/roman.mjs: it converts an integer from 1 to 3999 into its standard Roman numeral using subtractive notation (4 is IV, 9 is IX, 40 is XL, 90 is XC, 400 is CD, 900 is CM). Anything else (zero, negative, above 3999, non-integer) must throw a RangeError.
acceptance: out-of-range or non-integer input throws RangeError
